blocks.text: There’s a popular saying that no man is an island, but sometimes, a person just needs a moment for themselves, a chance to enjoy their own company. With the constant hurdles of life, taking time to be alone can offer a moment of peace. More than just a break from the noise, solo dates also can be a way to slow down, appreciate the little things and foster self discovery without outside influence.
